name: VC Port
subtitle: VeraCrypt-compatible volumes on iPhone, built from source
description: Sideload VC Port. The app stays offline, uses no trackers, and is not named VeraCrypt. Portions are based in part on TrueCrypt, freely available at http://www.truecrypt.org/

apps.name: VC Port
apps.subtitle: Open VeraCrypt-compatible containers offline
apps.localizedDescription:
VC Port opens VeraCrypt-compatible volumes on iPhone, shares encrypted containers as-is, and wraps individual files. No ads, analytics, or crash reporters. Volume passwords stay on device behind Face ID / Touch ID.

Portions of this product are based in part on TrueCrypt, freely available at http://www.truecrypt.org/

This derived work is not named VeraCrypt. Not unbreakable.

Contact: shivampingaledev@proton.me / shivampingaledev@gmail.com

Footnote: A programming noob with a five-year IT engineering degree that did not work out. Just trying to make something better that he likes to use, without much knowledge. Open to suggestions and advice.
